system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Harden CentOS 9 Server
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    pwquality_conf: |
      minlen = 14
      minclass = 4
      dcredit = -1
      ucredit = -1
      lcredit = -1
      ocredit = -1
      maxrepeat = 3
      maxclassrepeat = 3
      difok = 4
      retry = 3
      enforcing = 1
      dictcheck = 1
    fail2ban_jail_local: |
      [DEFAULT]
      bantime = 1h
      findtime = 15m
      maxretry = 5
      backend = systemd
      banaction = firewalld
      usedns = warn
      ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1

      [sshd]
      enabled = true
      mode = aggressive
      port = ssh
      logpath = %(sshd_log)s
      maxretry = 5
      findtime = 15m
      bantime = 1h
    auditd_config:
      log_format: RAW
      log_file: /var/log/audit/audit.log
      write_logs: yes
      flush: incremental_async
      freq: 50
      num_logs: 5
      name_format: HOSTNAME
      max_log_file: 50
      max_log_file_action: rotate
      space_left: 75
      space_left_action: email
      action_mail_acct: root
      admin_space_left: 50
      admin_space_left_action: single
      disk_full_action: single
      disk_error_action: single
    sshd_hardening_conf: |
      # Ansible managed hardening for SSHD
      PermitRootLogin no
      PermitEmptyPasswords no
      PubkeyAuthentication yes
      PasswordAuthentication yes
      X11Forwarding no
      ClientAliveInterval 300
      ClientAliveCountMax 2
      LoginGraceTime 30
      UsePAM yes
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure EPEL repository is enabled (CentOS)
      package:
        name: epel-release
        state: present
      when: "'CentOS' in ansible_facts['distribution']"

    - name: Install required packages
      package:
        name:
          - openssh-server
          - libpwquality
          - fail2ban
          - firewalld
          - audit
        state: present

    - name: Ensure SSHD service is enabled and running
      systemd:
        name: sshd
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Deploy SSH hardening drop-in
      copy:
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-hardening.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: "{{ sshd_hardening_conf }}"
      notify: Validate and reload sshd

    - name: Ensure password quality configuration is enforced
      copy:
        dest: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: "{{ pwquality_conf }}"

    - name: Check for authselect availability
      stat:
        path: /usr/bin/authselect
      register: authselect

    - name: Get current authselect profile details
      command: authselect current
      when: authselect.stat.exists
      register: authselect_current
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false

    - name: Enable with-pwquality feature in authselect
      command: authselect enable-feature with-pwquality
      when:
        - authselect.stat.exists
        - authselect_current.stdout is defined
        - "'with-pwquality' not in authselect_current.stdout"
      notify: Apply authselect changes

    - name: Ensure firewalld service is enabled and running
      systemd:
        name: firewalld
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Configure fail2ban
      copy:
        dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: "{{ fail2ban_jail_local }}"
      notify: Restart fail2ban

    - name: Ensure fail2ban service is enabled and running
      systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Ensure auditd is enabled and running
      systemd:
        name: auditd
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Configure auditd.conf settings
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: '^#?\s*{{ item.key }}\s*=.*'
        line: '{{ item.key }} = {{ item.value }}'
        state: present
        create: no
        backup: yes
      loop: "{{ auditd_config|dict2items }}"
      notify: Reload auditd

    - name: Deploy audit rules
      copy:
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/99-hardening.rules
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0640'
        content: |
          ## Ansible managed - Auditd Hardening Rules

          ## Increase buffer size
          -b 8192

          ## Disable previous rules
          -D

          ## Time change events
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex,settimeofday,clock_settime -k time-change
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex,settimeofday,clock_settime -k time-change
          -w /etc/localtime -p wa -k time-change

          ## Identity changes
          -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
          -w /etc/security/opasswd -p wa -k identity

          ## System locale and network
          -w /etc/issue -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/issue.net -p wa -k system-locale
          -w /etc/hosts -p wa -k network
          -w /etc/sysconfig/network -p wa -k network

          ## Login/logout events
          -w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/run/utmp -p wa -k session
          -w /var/log/wtmp -p wa -k logins
          -w /var/log/btmp -p wa -k logins

          ## Sudoers changes and privilege escalation related files
          -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope
          -w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope
          -w /usr/bin/sudo -p x -k priv_esc
          -w /bin/su -p x -k priv_esc

          ## SSH configuration changes
          -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k cfg
          -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ -p wa -k cfg

          ## MAC policy (SELinux) changes
          -w /etc/selinux/ -p wa -k MAC-policy

          ## Mount operations
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k mounts
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S mount -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k mounts

          ## File permission modifications
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod

          ## Unsuccessful file access attempts
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access

          ## File deletions by users
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S unlink,unlinkat,rename,renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S unlink,unlinkat,rename,renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S truncate,ftruncate -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S truncate,ftruncate -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete

          ## Kernel module loading/unloading
          -w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,finit_module,delete_module -k modules
      notify: Load audit rules

  handlers:
    - name: Validate and reload sshd
      listen: Validate and reload sshd
      block:
        - name: Validate sshd configuration
          command: /usr/sbin/sshd -t
        - name: Reload sshd
          systemd:
            name: sshd
            state: reloaded

    - name: Restart fail2ban
      listen: Restart fail2ban
      systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: Load audit rules
      listen: Load audit rules
      command: augenrules --load

    - name: Reload auditd
      listen: Reload auditd
      systemd:
        name: auditd
        state: reloaded

    - name: Apply authselect changes
      listen: Apply authselect changes
      command: authselect apply-changes -b

          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S chmod,fchmod,fchmodat,chown,fchown,fchownat,lchown,setxattr,lsetxattr,fsetxattr,removexattr,lremovexattr,fremovexattr -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k perm_mod

          ## Unsuccessful file access attempts
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EACCES -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S creat,open,openat,truncate,ftruncate -F exit=-EPERM -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k access

          ## File deletions by users
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S unlink,unlinkat,rename,renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S unlink,unlinkat,rename,renameat -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S truncate,ftruncate -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete
          -a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S truncate,ftruncate -F auid>=1000 -F auid!=unset -k delete

          ## Kernel module loading/unloading
          -w /sbin/insmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k modules
          -w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k modules
          -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S init_module,finit_module,delete_module -k modules
      notify: Load audit rules

  handlers:
    - name: Validate and reload sshd
      listen: Validate and reload sshd
      block:
        - name: Validate sshd configuration
          command: /usr/sbin/sshd -t
        - name: Reload sshd
          systemd:
            name: sshd
            state: reloaded

    - name: Restart fail2ban
      listen: Restart fail2ban
      systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: Load audit rules
      listen: Load audit rules
      command: augenrules --load

    - name: Reload auditd
      listen: Reload auditd
      systemd:
        name: auditd
        state: reloaded

    - name: Apply authselect changes
      listen: Apply authselect changes
      command: authselect apply-changes -b
